On their Sunday walk, Utterson and Enfield stop at the by-street door. Enfield says the Hyde affair is over, but Utterson admits he once saw Hyde and felt the same repulsion. Enfield reveals the door is Dr. Jekyll's back way. Looking up, Utterson sees Jekyll sadly at the middle window. Jekyll says he is very low and it will not last long. He declines their walk, saying he dare not. When Utterson suggests talking from below, Jekyll's smile becomes abject terror and the window is thrust down. The two men leave the court in silence, pale with horror, Utterson saying “God forgive us” twice.

After dinner, Utterson stays behind with Dr. Jekyll and raises the will. Jekyll calls Lanyon a hide-bound pedant. When Utterson mentions young Hyde, Jekyll pales and refuses to hear more. Utterson offers confidential help, but Jekyll says he can be rid of Hyde whenever he chooses, yet takes great interest in him. Jekyll asks Utterson to help Hyde for his sake when he is gone. Utterson promises to bear with Hyde and get his rights.
阿Q与人吵架，自称先前比对方阔得多；老头子当众颂扬他真能做，阿Q很喜欢。闲人拿他癞疮疤取笑，喊亮起来了，又揪住他黄辫子碰响头后得胜而去，还逼他自认人打畜生，阿Q自认虫豸，反以自轻自贱为第一个而心满意足得胜。后来阿Q赢钱后赌摊打架，洋钱尽失，便自打嘴巴，转败为胜，心满意足躺下。

A maid saw Hyde cane Sir Danvers Carew to death and fainted. At two she called police; the mangled body bore a sealed envelope for Utterson, who identified Carew. Inspector Newcomen showed the broken stick, which Utterson recognized as Jekyll’s gift. They searched Hyde’s rooms, finding the other half and a burnt cheque book. Hyde had thousands at the bank, but few familiars, no photograph, and wildly differing descriptions.
阿Q因小尼姑之事夜里难以合眼，想到该有个女人，否则断子绝孙。他在赵家厨房向吴妈下跪求困觉，吴妈发抖大叫着往外跑。秀才拿大竹杠打骂阿Q，阿Q逃入舂米场仍去舂米。少奶奶拖吴妈出下房，邹七嫂劝她不要寻短见。阿Q见赵太爷拿竹杠奔来，翻身逃走。地保来教训阿Q，定下五条件并索酒钱。阿Q质了棉被履行条约，赤膊磕头。

阿Q回土谷祠后省悟古怪在于自己赤膊，未庄女人见他便躲，邹七嫂也叫女儿进去。酒店不再赊欠，管祠老头子催他走。多日无人叫工，他饿着打听出众人改叫小D，小D谋了他的饭碗。阿Q在钱府照壁前遇小D，扑上去互拔辫子，相持半点钟后同时放手退开。他卖尽棉被毡帽布衫棉袄，决计出门求食，翻墙进静修庵菜园拔萝卜，小尼姑探头又缩回，老尼姑出来斥他偷萝卜，阿Q抵赖后拔步便跑，被黑狗追咬，爬上桑树滚出墙外。吃完三个萝卜，他打定进城的主意。

举人老爷的船夜到赵府河埠头，邹七嫂说箱是破衣箱已被赵太爷回复。阿Q听说举人老爷怕革命党而神往，醉后大喊造反了。赵太爷怯叫老Q，秀才直呼阿Q。赵白眼探口风，阿Q说其比己有钱，赵白眼回家把搭连交女人藏箱底。管祠老头子请阿Q喝茶，阿Q要饼和烛，幻想革命党叫他同去，梦中排序该杀之人，包括小D、赵太爷、秀才、钱太爷的大儿子、王胡。秀才与洋鬼子到静修庵革命打老尼姑，阿Q到静修庵问革命，老尼姑关门。

During a Sunday walk, Utterson and Enfield stop at a sinister door. Enfield recalls a story: a man trampled a girl, then paid her family £100 with a cheque. The cheque proved genuine. Enfield names the man Hyde, deformed and detestable, who still holds the key. Utterson says he knows the other party’s name. They agree never to speak of it again.

阿Q因被赵太爷打嘴巴出了名，付给地保二百文酒钱后忿忿躺下，又自认是赵太爷的父亲而得意起来。他与王胡并排坐下捉虱子，因捉得不如王胡多而心中不平，骂王胡毛虫，被王胡抓住辫子撞墙五下，受了生平第一件屈辱。他又骂钱太爷的大儿子秃儿驴，被其用哭丧棒打头，挨打后指认近旁孩子，又连挨几下。阿Q迎上小尼姑吐唾沫并骂她，伸手摩她新剃的头皮并调笑，扭住她面颊用力一拧。酒店里的人两次大笑，阿Q更加得意，小尼姑带哭地骂他断子绝孙。

Poole comes to Utterson at night, fearing foul play. They walk to Jekyll’s house, where servants huddle terrified. Poole leads Utterson to the cabinet; a changed voice refuses them. Poole claims Jekyll was murdered eight days ago and saw a masked dwarf—Mr. Hyde. Utterson resolves to break in. Poole strikes the door five times with an axe. Inside lies Hyde’s contorted body, a crushed phial nearby. They search for Jekyll but find only chemicals, a blasphemous book, a will naming Utterson, and a sealed packet. Utterson plans to read the documents and return before midnight.
叙述者决意给阿Q作正传，为名目犯难，最终取“正传”二字。阿Q酒后自称与赵太爷是本家，比秀才长三辈，地保便叫他去赵家，赵太爷喝骂并打他嘴巴，斥他不配姓赵，阿Q不抗辩。阿Q与地保退出，被地保训斥并谢二百文酒钱。叙述者问茂才先生阿Q名字写法，对方茫然；又托同乡查案卷，无果，遂写作阿Q。叙述者不知阿Q籍贯，只知其多住未庄。

赵家遭抢四天后，阿Q半夜被兵警抓进县城，关进栅栏小屋。他上大堂见光头老头子，身不由己跪下，供称“因为我想造反”，又答不知同党下落。被令画花押，圆圈画成瓜子模样。举人老爷与把总为追赃还是示众呕气。阿Q被穿白背心、反缚双手，抬上无篷车游街。他在人群中发见吴妈，喊出半句“过了二十年又是一个……”，看客发出豺狼嗥叫般喝采。他想起饿狼眼睛，觉得灵魂被咬，未喊救命便仿佛微尘迸散而死。举人老爷因终未追赃全家号咷，赵太爷的儿子茂才先生上城报官被革命党翦了辫子，城里舆论不满枪毙不如杀头好看。

Poole admits Utterson to Jekyll’s cabinet. Utterson asks if Jekyll has heard the news; Jekyll swears he will never see Hyde again. Jekyll gives Utterson a letter signed Edward Hyde, saying he burned the envelope, which had no postmark, and that Hyde dictated his will. Poole says no letter came except by post. Hearing newsboys cry an M.P.’s murder, Utterson shows Guest the murderer’s letter. Guest finds it identical to Jekyll’s note. Utterson locks it in his safe, suspecting forgery.

阿Q听说革命党进城后无大异样，便放弃进城寻友。未庄人陆续将辫子盘在顶上，茂才公最先，赵司晨、赵白眼、阿Q也相继效仿。阿Q见小D也盘辫，怒目而视吐唾沫。赵秀才托假洋鬼子带信并介绍进自由党，假洋鬼子讨还四块洋钱，秀才得银桃子。阿Q去钱府想投革命，被假洋鬼子喝令滚出去，忧愁前程被一笔勾销。夜里阿Q遇小D，得知赵家遭抢，暗中看见白盔白甲的人搬走赵家箱笼器具，回土谷祠痛恨假洋鬼子，想告状害他。

After Sir Danvers Carew’s murder, Hyde vanishes and rewards are offered. Jekyll resumes old friendships, dining with Utterson and Lanyon. Then Jekyll shuts his door; Poole says he is confined. Utterson finds Lanyon decayed, doomed, refusing Jekyll’s name. Jekyll writes of an incurable quarrel and extreme seclusion. Lanyon dies within a fortnight. After the funeral, Utterson opens Lanyon’s sealed envelope, not to be opened till Jekyll’s death or disappearance. Utterson prefers speaking with Poole at the door; Poole reports Jekyll confines himself over the laboratory, silent.

Utterson returns home troubled and studies Jekyll’s will, which leaves everything to Edward Hyde if Jekyll vanishes. He calls it madness and fears disgrace. At Cavendish Square, Lanyon says Jekyll grew too fanciful years ago and has never heard of Hyde. Unable to sleep, Utterson resolves to hunt Hyde. Keeping watch by the by-street door, he accosts a small man with a key, who admits Jekyll is out, gives his Soho address, then snarls and disappears inside. At Jekyll’s house, Poole confirms Hyde has a key, comes by the dissecting room, and all servants must obey him. Utterson goes home fearing Jekyll is in deep waters.
